question:
The figure is an aerial photo of a parking lot. Overlay a 4x4 grid on the image: cell (r, c) means row r counting from the top and column c counting from the left, both 1-based. Exactly one grid cell contains exactly 2 cars (by car centre). Scan the grid systematically — which cell is it?
(A) (3, 2)
(B) (1, 3)
(C) (1, 2)
(D) (2, 1)

Answer with only the correct option letter.
